component.name: DonutMonitorControl
component.summary: Control monitor brightness, color and input over DDC/CI

description.p: DonutMonitorControl talks to your monitors over DDC/CI. Set brightness, contrast, color preset and input source from one window, and let a background service follow the sun so the screen is dimmer at night and brighter at midday.

ul.li: Brightness follows solar elevation at your location
Pauses auto brightness while a window is fullscreen on a monitor
KDE Plasma brightness integration, with ddcutil and raw I2C for other monitors

description.p: Renamed from Monitor Remote Control to DonutMonitorControl. The daemon now runs from the packaged systemd user unit, and the GUI and daemon share one config file.
